legacy_corrections.text: Despite its title, RECALL PROCEDURE CODES is not limited to recallable codes on this report: any procedure code can be chosen.
ALL = every completed procedure code, which makes a very long report.
PROCEDURE DATE RANGE is matched on the date the procedure was completed.
TRANSACTION PROVIDER is the provider on the ledger line of the completed procedure.

Hidden population rule with no criteria control: accounts marked for collection (Send to Collection) are left out of the report. The vendor article concerns the procedural recall report; the document states the rule for all four recall reports.

legacy_corrections.text: SCHEDULED DATE RANGE filters on the date of the scheduled appointment, not on the recall due date.
PREFERRED PROVIDER and PREFERRED HYGIENIST filter on the patient's preferred provider / hygienist from Patient Information.

A recall counts as scheduled only when the recallable procedure code is embedded in the future appointment: the scheduled recall date is filled from that appointment, and an appointment that does not carry the code does not make the recall scheduled.

legacy_corrections.text: Include Inactive Patients is the last control of the panel: nothing lies below the row that the action bar cuts, so the criteria are complete as transcribed.
The range is applied to the recall due date: a future range lists upcoming recalls, a past range overdue ones.

Scheduled / Not Scheduled test whether a future appointment contains the recall code - a patient who is booked but whose appointment does not carry the code still lists as not scheduled. Not Scheduled is the working list.
Scheduled / Not Scheduled is evaluated per recall code: a patient with two of three codes scheduled still lists for the third.
ALL = every recallable code; the vendor advises choosing anchor codes only (for example the adult / child prophylaxis codes).
PREFERRED PROVIDER and PREFERRED HYGIENIST filter on the patient's preferred provider / hygienist.
Not Scheduled reproduces the former menu report Recall Due/Overdue but Not Scheduled Report.

TRANSACTION PROVIDER is the provider on the ledger line of the completed procedure.
